baseline: Installed Terra Invicta 1.0.53b + EEO 0.10.23 source overrides; analysis only, 2026-11-03

method.cycle: cooldown_s + (salvo_shots-1)*intraSalvoCooldown_s; nominal continuous fire, native averageCooldown
method.resources: baseWeaponMass_tons * build proportions * 0.1 + magazineMass_t * ammo proportions * 0.1
method.limits: No officer effects, bonus utilities, relative closing velocity, target armor, interception, misses, target loss, power/cooling limitations or native +/-1 second shot jitter. Raw energy is not observed combat damage.
